mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.employee_id, m.login_id, m.password, m.role, m.status, m.region_id, e.name, e.email FROM manager m JOIN employee e ON e.id = m.employee_id WHERE m.login_id = #{loginId}

SELECT m.id, m.login_id, m.role, m.status, m.region_id, r.name AS region_name, e.name, e.email, e.phone FROM manager m JOIN employee e ON e.id = m.employee_id LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = m.region_id WHERE m.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manager WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status != 'WITHDRAWN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manager (employee_id, login_id, password, role, status) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{role}, #{status})
